sources.title: Ubitus September 9 English Maizuru project announcement

sources.title: Maizuru March 2026 magazine pages 12–13: Ubitus property
sources.summary: March 2026 municipal magazine identifies Ubitus project at Taira Industrial Park and reports 23,385 square metres of site area. Month precision only; no exact publication day supplied.

The park is 9.6 ha; the selected locator is inside the specifically marked 2.3 ha property, not the entire industrial park. Historical plan supplies identity and spatial context only.
